question: Does pre-touch Pyharmonics confluence improve the unchanged original-score eight Monday1618 strategies?
single_variable: Add a pre-touch harmonic confluence gate to original admission; freeze original touch-bar score, entries, targets, stops, adds, costs and capital allocators.
fee_snapshot: OKX Lv1 2026-10-23; entry/target maker, other exits taker; native net already includes fees.
missing_score: V2/spike/allin3 accept missing scores. V3-family cannot choose the original score-based target, so records remain in coverage as unavailable, never imputed.
nonpositive_size: Original linear allocator clips nonpositive score-derived allocation to zero; preserve and count these unfunded opportunities.
add_gate: Retain original score>=0.6 add eligibility, -5percent level and parent-linked native cancellation; only primary admission is replaced.
control: Same pre-existing symbol/NY-week/side/prior14TR bucket random orders, unchanged native rules and zero unfilled controls. Generate only missing controls for harmonic-selected events. Additional incremental filter comparison uses week-clustered retained-minus-rejected means.
accounting: Reuse 20261028 allocator functions, original tie seeds/counts and annual restarts. All-in external replenishments are separate cashflow, never investment return. Per-trade worse OHLC/OLHC convention, original OHLC child-fill universe and realized-equity MAE liquidation proxy retained.
limitations: The owner explicitly requests the original fill-bar score convention, including its known lookahead. This is a historical replica comparison, not executable at the earlier fill. Rules/filter selected on the same history; no funding or exchange margin model; source Binance, paper OKX. BE17 remains unchanged, not the older booklet BE0 version.
reuse: All baseline signal fills are reused. Only missing selected-event matched controls can run natively. No fitting or production changes.

harmonic.patterns: All library XABCD names; no ABC/ABCD-only candidates
harmonic.candidate: formed or forming at the latest same-side price pivot; XABC have full left/right peak_spacing observations
harmonic.confluence: Original 1.618 limit lies inside intersection of tolerance-adjusted X(A or C)D and BCD completion bands; direction matches trade
harmonic.invalidation: No earlier excursion past far PRZ edge after C; no return beyond C after D
harmonic.prz: Use search.PATTERNS ratio definitions; bullish anchor max(A,C), bearish min(A,C), matching library fib matrix. Do not use asymmetric bearish Pattern.completion_* helper.
harmonic.clock: Prefix ends immediately before the touch 5m bar opens. Only already closed bars; no touch-bar OHLC or later data. Tail D may be provisional; XABC must be confirmed.
harmonic.missing: Insufficient or noncontiguous last 1000 bars are explicit unavailable; compare all and common observable baselines.
harmonic.candidate_validation: Reject forming() candidates whose actual XABC prices violate its own tolerance-adjusted XAB or ABC table; raw library joins retained. Source audit correction before return comparison.
